fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution of the perl binary with the "-e" flag and common strings related to potential reverse shell activity
fields.name: Potential Perl Reverse Shell Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "/perl" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -e ") and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "fdopen(" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "::Socket::INET") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "Socket" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "connect" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "open" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "exec"))))
